detail.title: Challenging Epistemic Self-Correction Assumptions
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Continuing active work on assumption challenge based on newly revised notebook findings.

detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity
detail.question: How can durable state and mechanical constraints enable fresh model invocations to function as a singular, accountable process?
detail.reason: The objective requires reconciling independent, stateless invocations with a durable, verifiable history. Existing evidence on handling global constraints (source-68e294ecf9e64b50) and context-aware flow (source-ac8f7017b6e44a91) provides a starting point for assessing this feasibility.
